blocks.content: Quiz: What is the best approach for resetting a Zustand store to its initial values?
Tap an option below to answer:
Call create() again to make a new store
Calling create() again would make a completely separate store. That is not a reset.
Calling create() again would make a completely separate store. That is not a reset.
Define the initial state as a separate object and use it in a reset action
Correct! Defining initialState separately means you can spread it into create() and use it in a reset action. One source of truth for your defaults.
Correct! Defining initialState separately means you can spread it into create() and use it in a reset action. One source of truth for your defaults.
Reloading the page is not a controlled reset. It also loses any data the user has not saved.
Reloading the page is not a controlled reset. It also loses any data the user has not saved.
Set each piece of state back to its default value one by one inside the component
Setting state one by one is error-prone and puts store logic inside a component where it does not belong.
Setting state one by one is error-prone and puts store logic inside a component where it does not belong.
